name: 林群哲
objective:
大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生：(A) 認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值 (B) 有效學習 (C) 涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。依據提供服務準則, 工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康, 安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
"First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(A) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(B) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(C) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1) Description of engineering ethics (2) Conflict and selection (3) Rule and explanation (4) Case study for student studied.
materials:
1. 多元學習 - 在原教室 - 帶班老師使用 google meet 連結，教務處直播說明。
2. 職能測驗 - 在原班教室上課 - 由研發處安排講師直接入班說明。
3. 合院演講第一場 : 性平、反詐騙講座 - 已安排講師、演講廳。
4. 合院演講第二場 : English Producer 101、永續淨零碳排講座 - 已安排講師、演講廳，推動英文學習環境與實施 EMI 課程。
5. 圖書館、紅樓參觀 (在圖書館集合)，依上面日期安排，少數無法安排在前 9 週的班級，可調課，請務必與相關單位事先聯繫。
6. 自訂主題、工程倫理 : 由帶班老師安排課程。
consultation: (1) 教師諮商時間 Office Hours (Monday: 13:00 ~ 15:00; Wednesday: 13:00 ~ 15:00; Thursday: 13:00 ~ 15:00)(2) e-mail (3) 視訊 video
延伸教學與資源: ● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources) 採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 使用生成式 AI 進行課堂即時互動（Use generative AI for real-time classroom interaction）
